technique_hints.name: Brute Force
technique_hints.why: High authentication failure rate can indicate password guessing or credential stuffing.

technique_hints.name: Valid Accounts
technique_hints.why: One account or entity appearing from many IPs can indicate account sharing or compromise.

technique_hints.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
technique_hints.why: Unusually high data volume can indicate collection or exfiltration behavior.

recommended_actions: Review authentication logs for password spraying, credential stuffing, and account lockout events.
Check impossible-travel patterns and validate whether source IPs match expected user locations.
Inspect transferred data volume and confirm whether the activity matches a legitimate business workflow.
